start: Any page of an online gym's panel, signed in as the owner, top bar

steps.action: Open the panel and look at the top bar
user_sees: A 'Refresh' button with 'Updated just now'
must_not: A time before any read has worked
The line in the demo gym, which never reads a server

steps.action: Wait 25 seconds, then 70 seconds, with the tab in view
user_sees: 'Updated 20 s ago' (it moves in steps of 10 seconds, and resets when the next read lands)
After a minute with no read: 'Updated 1 min ago'
must_not: The whole page redrawing or scrolling each time the line changes
A count that runs backwards

steps.action: Tap 'Refresh'
user_sees: The mark turns and the button reads 'Refreshing…'
Then 'Updated just now' and the newest records on the page, at the same scroll place
must_not: The page jumping to the top
'Updated just now' when a read failed

start: The panel left open in a browser tab that was hidden for ten minutes

steps.action: Come back to the tab
user_sees: The panel reads again at once and the line goes to 'Updated just now'
must_not: Old records shown under 'Updated just now'
Reads carrying on while the tab was hidden

steps.action: On a phone, look at the small round button in the top bar
user_sees: The refresh mark with a short age under it
must_not: The age cut off or over the mark

start: Top bar of the panel, internet switched off

steps.action: Tap 'Refresh'
user_sees: 'Could not refresh. Check the internet and try again.' and a red edge on the button (a '!' on the small phone button)
must_not: 'Updated just now'
The age reset to zero

steps.action: Leave the panel open for over an hour with no internet
user_sees: 'Updated over an hour ago'
must_not: A fresh-looking time
The button gone

steps.action: Open a gym that keeps its records only in this browser
user_sees: No Refresh button and no line
must_not: 'Updated just now' for a gym that reads no server

start: Top bar, a refresh that just failed

steps.action: Turn the internet on and tap 'Refresh' again
user_sees: 'Refreshing…', then 'Updated just now'; the red edge is gone
must_not: The failed words staying after a good refresh

steps.action: Tap 'Refresh' twice fast
user_sees: One refresh; the second tap does nothing while it is busy
must_not: Two reads at once
A stuck 'Refreshing…'
